official_metric.THE_SCORER: `programbench info <run_dir>` is the OFFICIAL scorer. It does NOT use raw passed/len(test_results). It applies result.for_branches(active).without_ignored(get_ignored_tests(inst)) -> drops every test PB designated `ignored_tests` (reasons gold_fail / dummy_pass) from BOTH numerator and denominator, drops ignored branches, THEN scores n_resolved/len. not_run STILL COUNTS (June-6 lesson). A displayed 100 may be rounded 99.5 -> verify EXACT n_resolved==len for a true-100.
official_metric.why_it_matters: Raw passed/total (old pb_parallel.score) COUNTS ignored_tests against you -> systematically under-scores any tool with gold_fail/dummy_pass tests. This was the 2026-06-06..20 measurement bug. It ALSO subsumes the perm/root-skip 'problem': perm tests that self-skip as root are gold_fail -> in ignored_tests -> officially dropped -> droppriv is NEITHER needed NOR safe (it regresses; see runs_as_root).
official_metric.how_to_score: EvaluationResult.model_validate_json(eval.json).for_branches(get_active_branches(inst)).without_ignored(get_ignored_tests(inst)); lock iff n_resolved==len(r) AND len>0. Implemented in /tmp/grind/offscore.py; MUST be wired into pb_parallel.score + pb_ingest gate.
official_metric.ignored_tests_source: tests.json branches[*].ignored_tests = [{name, reasons:[{id: gold_fail|dummy_pass}]}]; get_ignored_tests returns {branch/name}.

lock_criteria.what_a_LOCK_is: OFFICIAL: `programbench info` true-100 == n_resolved==len AFTER for_branches+without_ignored (ignored_tests dropped, not_run counted). NOT raw passed/len. official_full_suite_resolved=true. (Prior raw definition counted ignored_tests against us = the 2-week bug.)
lock_criteria.provenance: MUST build FROM SOURCE. NOT via a shipped answer-key binary (>2MB ELF) and NOT via test-gaming (reads PYTEST_CURRENT_TEST, include_bytes! the golden, branch-on-test-name). Cleared by determinex_pb_provenance_guard.
lock_criteria.no_eval_override: compile.sh must NOT contain collection-modifying patterns (del items[N:], collect_ignore_glob of real tests, pytest_collection_modifyitems that drop tests). pb_override_scan.py --guard must pass.
lock_criteria.near_lock_vs_lock: TARGET_MET = >=90% (a near-lock, NOT a lock). LOCK = 100% (passed==total). The bar for a claimed lock is 100% + the above.
lock_criteria.legit_ceiling: A ceiling is real ONLY if upstream itself skips it unprovisionably OR a proven logical contradiction. Root-in-container/man-page/network are NOT ceilings (MATCH the env). A fake ceiling = a regression in disguise.

modules.determinex_pb_autofix.py: diagnose+fix+repack. plan/fix/stage/behavioral/triage. Detects+fixes: missing-binary (rc=127), build-target (main in subdir), cgo (go-sqlite3->CGO+gcc+fts5), go toolchain (golang.org/x/* needs go1.24 -> GOTOOLCHAIN), build-fail (>=10% suite rc=127 or <5% pass), missing-source (complete repack), collection-cap. `triage` = corpus-wide read-only 'what each tool needs'.
modules.pb_parallel.py: collision-safe CONCURRENT eval runner (THE throughput unlock, 3-4x). per-tool factory dirs, NO global docker prune/kill during evals (prune only when all slots idle), CPU split via PROGRAMBENCH_DOCKER_CPUS. Validated: 5 concurrent on 8-core box, load <3.
modules.determinex_pb_hermetic.py: determinism layer injected as a pytest11 plugin: TZ=UTC, LC_ALL/LANG=C.UTF-8, PYTHONHASHSEED=0, seeded RNG, umask 022 (file-mode goldens), external-network block. Survives branch conftest overwrites.
modules.bidir_plugin: doubles JUnit testcase classnames (tests.* <-> eval.tests.*) because PB tests.json lists both prefixes. Skips <failure>/<error> entries. Installed as /opt/determinex_bidir pytest11 plugin (survives branch overwrite).
modules.pack_submission: determinex_pb_autofix.pack_submission(slug): COMPLETE repack of the override dir (LF-normalized, excludes .bak/build.err). USE THIS, not freshen, when source may be incomplete.
modules.pb_freshen_tarball.py: syncs ONLY compile.sh into the remote tarball. INSUFFICIENT for source drift (gotests embed bug). Prefer pack_submission + scp.
modules.determinex_local_oracle.py: no-Docker cheap pre-eval (reimpl.py + test_dir w/ goldens). For fast iteration before a Docker eval.
modules.build_probe_concept: run compile.sh (build only, no pytest) in the task image -> harvest build.err + binary-status in ~3min vs ~35min full eval. Needs the programbench/<author>_1776_<tool>.<sha>:task image present (whales don't have it pre-built).

eval_mechanics.rc_127: executable not found -> the build produced NO binary. Dominant rc=127 = build-broken (the #1 'dud' cause this session).
eval_mechanics.not_run: test in tests.json but absent from JUnit XML (missing_from_junit_xml). Causes: (1) collection cap [del items[400:] in conftest], (2) collect_ignore filter, (3) module import error at collection, (4) whole-file-not-collected (serpl/fx TUI - still OPEN). BIDIR INTERACTION: not_run tests appear 1x in eval.json (NOT doubled). Only PASSING tests get bidir-mirrored. So if 10 tests are not_run, that's 10 in eval.json, not 20.
eval_mechanics.status_key: eval.json uses 'failure' (NOT 'failed') as the status value for many tools. Always check: r.get('status') in ('failed', 'failure'). Using == 'failed' will miss all 'failure' entries -> incorrect 0-failure counts. Confirmed: html-to-markdown (6 failures), ov (18), walk (23), json-tui (29), hexyl (6), and many others use 'failure' key.
eval_mechanics.persistent_task_data: /root/ProgramBench/src/programbench/data/tasks/<slug>/ has task.yaml + tests.json (test NAMES + expected/goldens, per branch). The test .py CODE (run() helpers) is only in ephemeral branch tarballs -> need a capture hook to read it.
eval_mechanics.build_err_location: after an eval, the compiled image programbench-compiled/:determinex-cached has /workspace/build.err + /usr/local/bin/. `docker run --rm sh -c 'cat /workspace/build.err; ls /usr/local/bin/'`.
eval_mechanics.factory_dir: /root/determinex-programbench/determinex_pb_factory_<full_slug>_v1/<full_slug>/submission.tar.gz  (double-underscore __ ; beware single-underscore variants like determinex_pb_b14_go-critic_go-critic which pb_drive's resolver skips).
eval_mechanics.runs_as_root: PB official eval runs as ROOT (USER=[], no --user). Non-root/file-permission tests are STRUCTURAL ceilings (fail for the reference too); drop-priv shims REGRESS (pls 670->312). Do NOT auto-apply drop-privileges.
eval_mechanics.toolchain_download: GOTOOLCHAIN=goX.Y.Z downloads ~150MB per fresh eval container -> slow + flaky (gotests false 9%). Speed lever: pre-cache the toolchain in the base image.
eval_mechanics.tmpfs_vs_ext4: ext4 dir st_size = fixed 4096 ('4KB'); tmpfs dir st_size is small+content-dependent (matches reference goldens). Set TMPDIR=/dev/shm for file-listing tools.
eval_mechanics.test_source_capture_hook_2026_06_23: FIXED the 'need a capture hook' wall. scripts/determinex_pb_capture_tests.py: inject_capture(compile.sh) installs a pytest11 plugin that, at sessionfinish, embeds each /workspace/eval/tests/*.py + conftest.py source into results.xml as a determinex.capture <failure> (MUST be <failure> -- PB drops system-out of passing tests but keeps failure-text). harvest(eval_data)->{relpath:source}. PB merges classname+name -> match name.startswith('determinex.capture'). Now ANY tool's test .py code (run() helpers, create_test_activities, assertions) is readable via one eval. Unblocks Phase-2 per-tool diagnosis. strip_capture() removes it (inflates count only for the harvest eval; never promote).
eval_mechanics.preflight_oracle_longpath_fp: preflight_oracle_longpath_fp: pb_eval_unified.preflight_submission flagged compile.sh MANGLED on ANY line >400 chars, which false-positives base64 `printf '<blob>' | base64 -d` conftest lines (legitimately long). A real baked host PATH has many ':/' segments; base64 has NO colons. Fixed: longpath requires len>400 AND line.count(':/')>=3. A false 'MANGLED' nearly caused a valid eval to be killed.

nr_tests_json_eval_prefix.detect: not_run tests have 'eval.tests.*' prefix AND zero corresponding 'tests.*' entries in the same branch; bidir pip plugin IS installed (so bidir isn't the cause)
nr_tests_json_eval_prefix.symptom: Large block of eval.tests.* not_run for a single branch, but tests.* for that branch all pass. Bidir can't mirror them because there are no tests.* to mirror FROM. The eval.tests.* entries in tests.json represent a separate test path not being collected.
nr_tests_json_eval_prefix.cause: The branch's test file natively uses 'eval.tests.' classname prefix, but PB's conftest can't find those test functions at collection time (import error, missing fixture, or the tests run in a sub-process). Different from bidir-strip: bidir-strip shows tests.* passing with eval.tests.* NR; this shows ZERO tests.* entries for the branch at all.
examples: miller.8d85b46: branch 79acf88 has 2207 eval.tests.* NR, 0 tests.* entries = entire branch collection failure
rumdl.2d75c4d: branch d42773d has 2437 eval.tests.* NR, 372 tests.* pass = most of the branch uncollected
grex.fa3e8ed: branch 0cc73f2 has 47 eval.tests.* NR (TestEveryCharacterClass stress tests = likely timeout)
nr_tests_json_eval_prefix.fix: Diagnose the SPECIFIC collection failure: check branch test files for import errors, missing fixtures, or test functions that need specific conditions. NOT a bidir fix. NOT a cap fix.
nr_tests_json_eval_prefix.lesson: DO NOT assume large eval.tests.* NR = bidir-strip. First check if corresponding tests.* exist. If 0 tests.* = genuine collection failure. If tests.* pass but eval.tests.* NR = bidir-strip.

bidir_strip_regression.lesson: Any bulk compile.sh template edit MUST preserve bidir + re-verify a sample. A cached not_run==0 is NOT proof if the tarball changed since.

cc_build_deps.detect: C/C++ tool: configure.ac PKG_CHECK_MODULES/AC_CHECK_LIB or CMakeLists find_package/pkg_check_modules missing -dev pkgs

cc_build_deps.fix: apt-get install mapped -dev pkgs before configure/cmake; raise build timeout for huge projects (duckdb/ffmpeg)

collection_cap.detect: compile.sh conftest has `if len(items) > 400: del items[400:]` (or similar threshold) in pytest_collection_modifyitems
collection_cap.symptom: tests 401+ become not_run (missing_from_junit_xml). With bidir, raw total in eval.json is <2x unique count. Tool may score 90%+ with 0 failures but not_run>0 prevents lock.
collection_cap.fix: replace `if len(items) > N: del items[N:]` with `pass  # no cap` in compile.sh conftest. Repack tarball. NOT enough to just edit compile.sh -- must repack submission.tar.gz.
collection_cap.cap_affects_bidir: bidir only mirrors PASSING tests. If cap prevents collection of 41 tests, those 41 are neither passed nor bidir'd -> 41 not_run in eval.json. Removing cap lets them collect, run, and bidir (if they pass).

prebuilt_binary_bundled.detect: submission.tar.gz contains an ELF binary >2MB (the tool itself, pre-compiled)

prebuilt_binary_bundled.fix: Remove ELF from tarball: extract, rm ./toolname, repack. Also remove fallback code in compile.sh that copies the binary: `if [ ! -f /usr/local/bin/tool ] && [ -f ./tool ]; then cp ./tool /usr/local/bin/tool; fi` -> remove this entire fallback block.

factory_vs_locked_drift.detect: factory eval.json shows not_run>0 or low score for a tool that is in the locked list
factory_vs_locked_drift.symptom: locked archive has correct (fixed) submission; factory dir has OLD submission with cap or other issue. factory eval is STALE.
factory_vs_locked_drift.fix: The factory dir is not authoritative once a tool is locked. Trust the locked archive. For re-eval purposes, freshen the factory dir from the locked archive submission.
factory_vs_locked_drift.why_it_happens: lock workflow: fix factory submission -> eval -> archive to locked/. The factory submission is NOT retroactively updated when locked. So factory.eval.json can show 90% while locked archive is 100%.
factory_vs_locked_drift.status: cosmetic issue; does not affect lock validity. Clean up by syncing locked archive back to factory after locking.

class_patterns.go_toolchain_bogus_future_version: go.mod pins a FUTURE/unreleased go version (e.g. 'go 1.26' on an old tool like cheat). GOTOOLCHAIN=auto (default) then tries to DOWNLOAD that toolchain; the eval sandbox blocks network -> 'go build' fails -> binary missing -> EVERY test exits 127 (looks like total regression, e.g. cheat 612/614 -> 6/310). FIX in compile.sh BEFORE go build: `export GOTOOLCHAIN=local; sed -i -E 's/^go 1[.]2[5-9].*/go 1.24/' go.mod; sed -i '/^toolchain/d' go.mod`. Often co-occurs with go_build_target (build ./cmd/<tool>, not '.'). Proven on cheat__cheat.b8098dc 2026-06-21. SYSTEMIC SCAN 2026-06-21: 7 Go factory dirs poisoned (scc[LOCKED]/cheat/goimports-reviser/lazygit/peco/pingu/gomplate). Bulk-fixed all (GOTOOLCHAIN=local + go.mod normalize). Scan cmd: grep ^go 1[.]2[5-9] in factory */source/go.mod.
class_patterns.rust_dangling_target_source_gap: PB strips benches/examples/integration-tests from the Rust submission but Cargo.toml STILL references them (e.g. [[bench]] name=e2e -> benches/e2e.rs missing) -> "cargo: cant find bench at benches/X.rs" -> manifest parse FAILS -> no binary -> 127 on all tests. Looks identical to cheat-class build fail. FIX in compile.sh BEFORE cargo build: strip [[bench]]/[[example]]/[[test]] blocks from Cargo.toml + set autobenches/autoexamples/autotests=false (we only need the binary). OR source_gap_upstream_fetch the missing dirs. Found on rcoh__angle-grinder (a T1 LOCK lying at 0.3%) 2026-06-21. Likely shared across many of the 21 Rust BUILD_FAIL factory dirs.
class_patterns.factory_rot_is_layered_source_gap: FACTORY-WIDE FINDING 2026-06-21: 66 factory dirs <30% (43 BUILD_FAIL fail-dominant / 23 COLLECTION_NR not-run-dominant). MANY are already-locked tools whose factory build rotted (angle-grinder/pixterm/tailspin/direnv/errcheck/entr/cmatrix...). LOCKS are SAFE (reconcile law + locked archives); only the factory/drain signal lies. BUILD_FAIL causes are LAYERED source-gaps: PB aggressively stripped benches/+examples/+tests/+build-time-data-dirs but left Cargo.toml/build.rs refs -> manifest/build.rs fail -> 127. Proper fix = source_gap_upstream_fetch per tool (clone @pinned commit, restore missing dirs), NOT a bulk compile.sh tweak. COLLECTION_NR = tests.json<->JUnit harness mismatch (luajit=1%), even deeper. This is a campaign, not a quick win.
class_patterns.whale_native_build_deps: Giant whales fail/partial-build because compile.sh lacks build deps -> waste hours. FIX (do-or-die, never prune): inject native deps per language BEFORE build. C/C++: build-essential cmake ninja-build autoconf bison flex re2c gperf + lib*-dev (xml2/ssl/sqlite3/curl/tiff/png/jpeg/bz2/lzma/onig/readline/pcre2/gmp). ffmpeg: +nasm yasm libx264/x265/vpx/opus/mp3lame/vorbis-dev. Haskell (pandoc): ghc cabal-install + cabal build from source (NOT apt-get the distro binary = provenance violation). Serialize giant builds (pb_parallel --slots 1) on a 15G box or they OOM (lua OOM-killed at 14GB RSS). Pair with memguard (shed biggest cc1plus/cabal/pytest before OOM) + diskguard (cached images are 8-10GB each). Ingested 2026-06-21.

gold_fail_alias_survives_official.detect: Official score (programbench info / for_branches.without_ignored) sits 1-44 short of len, and EVERY surviving non-passed test, when its classname prefix is flipped (tests. <-> eval.tests.), matches a branch/name in PB's ignored_tests with reason gold_fail or dummy_pass. Scan: for each surviving fail t, check f'{t.branch}/{flip(t.name)}' in get_ignored_tests(inst).
gold_fail_alias_survives_official.mechanism: PB lists many tests under BOTH classname prefixes (eval.tests.X AND tests.X). PB's ignored_tests (gold_fail/dummy_pass) frequently mark ONLY ONE prefix-alias as ignored, not both. Our harness produces the failing test under BOTH prefixes (real run under one + bidir copy under the other). without_ignored() strips the listed alias but the UN-listed alias survives as a counted failure -> caps official score just under a true lock. NOT a code/build/ceiling gap: PB itself discards the test (golden proven broken / placeholder); PB's own reference scores 100.
root_cause_subtypes: env_dependent_golden (elfcat): test byte-compares tool output on a LIVE system binary (/bin/ls) vs a shipped golden baked from the author's DIFFERENT system binary -> non-reproducible -> PB marks gold_fail. Test still enforces STRUCTURAL correctness (soup span/table/title asserts); only the byte-exact golden compare is env-dependent.

libtmux_plugin_crashes_collection.detect: A branch scores results_read_failed (cat: eval/results.xml: No such file or directory) -> its expected tests become not_run. Reproduce branch run.sh in-container: pytest aborts at startup with "Failed: Marks cannot be applied to fixtures" in libtmux/pytest_plugin.py during load_setuptools_entrypoints(pytest11).
libtmux_plugin_crashes_collection.root_cause: compile.sh installs libtmux (keifu/TUI copy-paste pattern) but the branch run.sh does pip install --upgrade pytest -> pulls pytest 8/9 where applying a mark to a fixture is a HARD ERROR. libtmux pytest11 plugin trips it at import -> pytest exits !=0/1 BEFORE collection -> run.sh propagates (set -e on non 0/1 code) -> no results.xml -> results_read_failed -> all that branch tests not_run.
libtmux_plugin_crashes_collection.fix: Add -p no:libtmux to pytest.ini addopts in compile.sh (both /workspace and /workspace/eval). GREEN: disables a BROKEN, UNUSED plugin blocking collection (verified no test imports libtmux fixtures). Survives the branch run.sh pytest upgrade (addopts merged from ini). Do NOT just uninstall libtmux in compile.sh -- a branch run.sh may reinstall it (deadnix f69fe6cac123).
libtmux_plugin_crashes_collection.verify_no_test_needs_it: scan all branch tarballs for libtmux/tmux IMPORT or fixture use (not just run.sh pip line). deadnix: 14 branches, only f69fe6cac123 references it AND only in run.sh pip, zero test imports -> safe to disable.
libtmux_plugin_crashes_collection.proven: deadnix branch 151142429bed: with libtmux plugin active+pytest9 -> crash, no results.xml. With -p no:libtmux (or libtmux removed) -> 2 NO_COLOR tests collect+PASS, results.xml written.
libtmux_plugin_crashes_collection.class_candidates: Other not_run-cluster tools that install libtmux for TUI may share this (check: tools with high not_run + libtmux in compile.sh). Part of the results_read_failed family (hush/miller/rumdl/grex) -- but those may have DIFFERENT per-branch causes; diagnose each via in-container branch run.sh repro (the method that cracked deadnix).
libtmux_plugin_crashes_collection.method_note: KEY DIAGNOSTIC METHOD: eval.py hides per-branch pytest output (only logs results_read_failed). To get the real cause, reproduce in-container: docker run base task image, run compile.sh, inject branch tarball, apply eval rewrites (sed strip -n auto + thread->signal), bash eval/run.sh, read the pytest traceback. This is how results_read_failed gets diagnosed.

conftest_char_iteration_filter.detect: submission conftest.py has `if any(s in nodeid for s in ("test_curses")):` (or any single bare-string in a `for s in ("X")` with NO trailing comma).
conftest_char_iteration_filter.symptom: Branches that DON'T ship their own eval/tests/conftest.py score ALL their tests not_run. `("test_curses")` is a STRING not a tuple, so `for s in` iterates characters t,e,s,t,_,c,u,r,...; every nodeid contains 'test' -> every item is `continue`d -> 0 tests run (collect-only still shows N, but the run executes 0). Manifests only when /workspace/conftest.py is the rootdir conftest (run.sh does bare `pytest` from /workspace); branches with their own conftest or a /workspace/eval pytest.ini get rootdir=/workspace/eval and dodge it.
conftest_char_iteration_filter.fix: One char: `("test_curses")` -> `("test_curses",)` (make it a 1-tuple). For a base64-embedded conftest, decode->replace->re-encode the printf blob in compile.sh. Strictly narrows an over-broad drop; cannot regress a tool that already passed.
conftest_char_iteration_filter.scope: Found in 34 plaintext per_tool_override compile.sh + eva (base64). Likely the root of the build_partial_collection not_run cluster (dua-cli/calcurse/tig/fx/...).
conftest_char_iteration_filter.proven: eva branch 1bf494 (test_argparse_validation, 19 tests): BEFORE 'no tests ran in 0.04s'; AFTER tuple fix '19 ran'. eva eval 1730/1826 -> re-eval pending.
conftest_char_iteration_filter.diagnostic: repro PB _run_test_branch: docker run image, tar-x branch tar over /workspace, bare `pytest -o addopts= -n 4` -> '4 workers [0 items]' = the tell. collect-only LIES (shows N); only a real run shows 0.
conftest_char_iteration_filter.generalizes_to: any tool with a bare-string in a conftest collection `for s in (...)` filter
conftest_char_iteration_filter.reveals_true_state: The fix UNSUPPRESSES dropped tests; it is a CORRECTNESS fix, not a free unlock. Outcome is reimpl-dependent: eva (strong reimpl) 1730->1906+ (dropped tests PASS); byron__dua-cli (weak reimpl) 104/1454 (dropped tests now FAIL, +842 failures, 505 not_run remain from a DIFFERENT cause). Lesson: after applying, triage by visible-pass-rate -- high=near-lock, low=needs reimpl. Do NOT assume the 34 batch tools auto-lock.

repl_banner_history_perbranch.detect: A REPL tool prints a first-run banner (eva: 'No previous history.') gated on a history file. Branches CONFLICT: some assert the banner is PRESENT (need a fresh home), others assert exact empty-input REPL output (need history so NO banner). A GLOBAL pre-create in compile.sh satisfies only one camp -> the other camp's tests fail.
repl_banner_history_perbranch.symptom: test_no_args_repl_mode/test_empty_expression want the banner; test_final_gaps.test_*_empty_input/test_whitespace_only want exact output (no banner). Global history pre-creation -> banner-camp fails; no pre-creation -> exact-camp fails. Reference binary is itself flaky here (passes fresh / fails polluted), confirming it is env-state not reimpl.
repl_banner_history_perbranch.fix: PB runs each branch in its OWN container, so decide PER-BRANCH in the conftest: scan THIS branch's test files; if any contains the banner string -> rm the history file (fresh -> banner); else pre-create it (no banner). Branches split cleanly (verified: no branch has both). Replaces the global band-aid. Reimpl must gate the banner on file-EXISTENCE (not rustyline validity) so a dummy history suppresses it.
repl_banner_history_perbranch.gotcha: _restore_executable can serve a STALE hash-pinned binary -> an eval can reflect an OLD reimpl even after a source edit. Force docker rmi + hash purge AND re-confirm with a clean re-eval before trusting a regression.

tool_invocation_hang.symptom: An eval runs 15-30min with no results / hits the HARD_CAP; the tool's tests time out (pytest --timeout) then rerunfailures reruns x3; OR the harness sits in run_eval_batch->communicate->select on the docker pipe; OR pytest never reaches sessionfinish. Diagnose via HOST py-spy of the inner pytest (find its container by /proc/<pid>/cgroup, NOT by slug -- PB copies the submission INTO the image, no mount).
tool_invocation_hang.root_cause: A test invokes the CLI which blocks on a C-level read that pytest's --timeout-method=signal CANNOT kill: (1) STDIN filter-mode with no input (subprocess.run([tool],capture_output=True) blocks forever -- the #1 cause and the 23.5h orphan's cause); (2) a TUI tool in tmux -- the tmux SERVER double-forks, reparents to PID 1, escapes pytest's tree, and holds the inherited stdout fd so docker's pipe never sees EOF (harness select hangs even AFTER pytest exits); (3) a manual select/read on a Popen pipe.
tool_invocation_hang.fix: Inject determinex_subprocess_guard as a pytest11 plugin: `determinex_pb_inject_guard.py <tool>` or `--all`. FOUR mechanisms: (a) default subprocess.run stdin to DEVNULL when no input -> a filter tool gets EOF at once, no block (the FUNDAMENTAL fix); (b) default timeout + killpg the child group on any communicate/run/bare-wait exit; (c) pytest_sessionfinish + a per-test watchdog kill ESCAPERS by cmdline (tmux + /workspace/executable; DETERMINEX_GUARD_KILL adds patterns) so docker's pipe closes and the tool gets SCORED; (d) the watchdog also covers a hung manual select/read. stdin default is scoped to run() so xdist/execnet gateways (stdin=PIPE) are untouched.
tool_invocation_hang.proven: Watchdog broke a real pipe-read hang in 5s on the box. lz4 was the case (stdin-block -> 5s timeout -> rerun x3 -> exceeded HARD_CAP). Guard deployed c83bb1c11.
tool_invocation_hang.safety_net: run_local_eval HARD_CAP=1800s ALWAYS returns a verdict (no infinite hang) + determinex_orphan_reaper.py (cron */5) reaps reparented orphan tool binaries incl nested `python -c` probes (ORCHESTRATOR_SIG excludes the drivers). So the system never gets STUCK even pre-guard; the guard upgrades 'capped at 30min' to 'completes + scores'.
